    return cart

# Caller 1

code:
def has_duplicates(items: list) -> bool:
    seen = []
    for item in items:
        if item in seen:  # O(n) lookup
            return True
        seen.append(item)
    return False

ground_truth.description: O(n²) — `item in list` is O(n); use a set for O(1) lookups
Synchronous fs in an async request handler blocks the entire event loop
MD5 is cryptographically broken for password hashing; use bcrypt/argon2/scrypt
random.random() uses Mersenne Twister, not cryptographically secure; use secrets module for tokens

Nested quantifier creates catastrophic backtracking — ReDoS vulnerability

String comparison is not constant-time; use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for secrets
Magic numbers (50, 25, 1000, 15, 0.5, 0.01) should be named constants for clarity
CORS wildcard origin with credentials=true is a dangerous combination — browsers reject it, but misconfigured proxies may pass it through
forEach ignores returned promises; use for...of or Promise.all to actually wait for async work

def process_xml(xml_file: str) -> str:
    tree = parse(xml_file)

    return root.text or ""
